name: telegram-video-downloader
description: Frontend + backend in one repo. Install once, run once.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/copy-frontend.js
